lines: Increasingly restless and agitated following recent hernia repair surgery
Two days after undergoing hernia repair, a 42-year-old man becomes increasingly restless and agitated.
He was calm and cooperative the previous day but is now visibly tremulous and pacing in his room.
He appears anxious, frequently requests to leave the hospital, and becomes irritable when questioned.
He is oriented to person only and reports seeing "spiders crawling on the wall," although no insects are present.
